paragraphs.text: The school in Brackwell closed in 2009, when only nine pupils were left. Families with children moved away, and the building was used as a store for farm machinery.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: In 2021 four families with young children bought houses in the village, and the council agreed to reopen the school for one class of mixed ages. A single teacher works there, helped by parents two mornings a week.
paragraphs.label: B

items.quote: closed in 2009, when only nine pupils were left
items.prompt: The school closed because the building was unsafe.

explanation.en: The reason is given — only nine pupils — not the building → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Жабылу себебі айтылған: тоғыз оқушы қалған, ғимарат жағдайы емес → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Причина закрытия названа: осталось девять учеников, а не состояние здания → FALSE.

items.quote: the building was used as a store for farm machinery
items.prompt: The building was empty between 2009 and 2021.

explanation.en: It was used as a store, so it was not empty → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Ғимарат қойма ретінде пайдаланылған, демек бос тұрмаған → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Здание использовали как склад, значит пустым оно не стояло → FALSE.

items.quote: reopen the school for one class of mixed ages
items.prompt: The new class has pupils of different ages.

explanation.en: “one class of mixed ages” — different ages in one class → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «one class of mixed ages» — бір сыныпта әртүрлі жас → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «one class of mixed ages» — разный возраст в одном классе → TRUE.

items.quote: A single teacher works there, helped by parents two mornings a week
items.prompt: The teacher previously worked in a city school.

explanation.en: The text says nothing about the teacher’s past work → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Мұғалімнің бұрынғы жұмысы туралы мәтінде ештеңе жоқ → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: О прошлом учителя в тексте ничего нет → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
